hero.title: Invest in Thailand with legal clarity
hero.subtitle: A regulated introduction platform connecting Thai majority investors (51%) with foreign entrepreneurs — viable business plans and lawyer-reviewed joint ventures.

sectionInvestors.title: For Thai investors
sectionInvestors.body: Become the majority shareholder in innovative international concepts. Full legal protection through joint-venture agreements drafted by licensed law firms.

sectionEntrepreneurs.title: For foreign entrepreneurs
sectionEntrepreneurs.body: Step out of the shadow of nominee structures. Find a real local partner to stabilise your business and obtain genuine ownership rights.

trust.title: Verification & compliance first
trust.body: Profiles and legal compliance are strictly verified so Thai investors can trust the structure, and entrepreneurs know agreements meet Thai regulatory expectations.

investorsPage.title: Thai majority investors
investorsPage.lead: Structured opportunities where Thai partners hold at least 51% — with contracts drafted by licensed firms and traceable compliance.
investorsPage.b1: Verify counterparties before introduction: ID checks and role clarity for investor_thai profiles.
investorsPage.b2: Joint-venture templates aligned with Thai corporate practice — MOU through shareholder agreements.
investorsPage.b3: Legal review stages tracked in-platform before capital commitments.
investorsPage.ctaBody: Investor onboarding, deal rooms, and KYB workflows will plug into this section — the database and API layer are ready.

projectsPage.title: Published opportunities
projectsPage.lead: Vetted summaries from entrepreneurs seeking a Thai-majority partner; amounts are indicative until legal DD closes.
projectsPage.emptyBody: Apply the SQL seed on D1 or publish drafts from the admin flow once wired. The API already exposes GET /v1/projects.

legalPage.title: Legal & compliance workflow
legalPage.lead: Documentation tracked end-to-end so Thai and foreign parties stay aligned — not legal advice; engage counsel for your deal.
legalPage.s1Body: Define scope, governance, and exclusivity before substantive spend.
legalPage.s2Body: Capital calls, board seats, dispute resolution, and Thai-majority safeguards.
legalPage.s3Body: Ordered signing for Thai and foreign parties; status moves from draft → signed → completed.
legalPage.disclaimer: General information only — retain Thai-qualified lawyers for binding advice.
